text: Build what the BRIEF.md addendum '2026-10-14: A loop that steers Athena, roles, and a ladder of requirements' asks for, starting small: roles as recorded definitions (A9, A10), and a first role that runs every 5 tasks in parallel with other work, looks at everything Athena has done, and queues work items, including one for anything it could not see. Record only what would otherwise be lost; pull the rest from where it lives. Use the ladder to decide what it may change itself.
